articles.title: Prime Minister Mark Carney speaks to the media after meetings in Saudi Arabia
articles.summary: Prime Minister Carney announced the results of his high-level meetings with Saudi Arabian officials and took questions from the media following his visit to the country.

articles.title: Carney courts Saudi Arabia as U.S.-Iran ceasefire collapses
articles.summary: Prime Minister Carney sought to deepen ties with Saudi Arabia while renewed U.S.-Iran fighting overshadowed his visit, with Canada condemning Iranian attacks and reaffirming regional security support.

articles.title: Carney appoints one of his top advisers and a Conservative MP to Senate
articles.summary: Prime Minister Carney made his first Senate appointments, including top adviser Tom Pitfield and Conservative MP Richard Martel, signaling a shift from his predecessor's nonpartisan approach.

articles.title: Carney backs latest U.S. strikes on Iran as Trump slams NATO allies
articles.summary: Prime Minister Carney endorsed the latest U.S. strikes on Iran as a justified response to ceasefire violations at the NATO summit in Ankara.

articles.title: Carney hails submarine deal as NATO win, moves to ease South Korea's disappointment
articles.summary: Prime Minister Carney celebrated Canada's submarine partnership with Germany and Norway at the NATO summit while meeting with South Korean officials to address their disappointment over losing the procurement competition.
